harness_profile_fragments.summary: Sub-agent-friendly profile with the RFC 0040 V1 no-questions instruction.
harness_profile_fragments.native_delegation_instruction: Use sub-agents aggressively for bounded independent research, review, and code/test/doc authorship. This is a one-shot supervised invocation: you cannot ask the operator a follow-up question. If permission to call `striatum ack` is denied, write the artifact and exit normally; the operator publishes on your behalf. Do not let native delegation obscure the parent session's artifact and verdict accountability.

harness_profile_fragments.summary: Encourages native delegation with the RFC 0040 V1 no-questions instruction.
harness_profile_fragments.native_delegation_instruction: Use native delegation aggressively for parallelizable work. The parent session remains accountable for Striatum artifacts, write scope, verification, and completion. This is a one-shot supervised invocation: you cannot ask the operator a follow-up question. If a step is ambiguous, choose the most-conservative default that matches the synthesis and proceed; the operator publishes the result on your behalf if your CLI access is denied.

harness_profile_fragments.summary: Adds the RFC 0040 V1 no-questions instruction and the front-matter completeness callout.
harness_profile_fragments.native_delegation_instruction: Use native delegation aggressively for parallelizable work. The parent session remains accountable for Striatum artifacts, write scope, verification, and completion. This is a one-shot supervised invocation: you cannot ask the operator a follow-up question. If a step is ambiguous, choose the most-conservative default that matches the synthesis and proceed; the operator publishes the result on your behalf if your CLI access is denied. When writing finding artifacts, ALL FIVE front-matter fields are required (none are optional): schema_version, artifact_kind, verdict_intent, severity, tags. Use verdict_intent (not verdict); severity from {low,medium,high,critical} (not none); tags as a JSON array; the author: byline is a plain markdown line AFTER the front-matter block, not a key inside it. Handoff artifacts (DESIGN.md / BUILD_HANDOFF.md) do not need front matter; just the plain author: byline.
